work_item.context:
Issue #103 — Add configurable delivery-policy severities

Extend the delivery-policy crate from required labels to a configurable rule system. Add public Severity (Advisory, Required), PolicyOptions, Rule, Violation, and expanded Decision APIs. Preserve parse_policy and the existing required-label behavior as compatibility wrappers.

Parsing: accept one rule per line as `severity:label`; ignore blank lines and `#` comments; normalize labels with trim + lowercase; reject unknown severities, empty labels, and duplicate normalized labels with a typed ParsePolicyError carrying the one-based line and a stable message. Add parse_policy_with_options. PolicyOptions controls whether advisory violations affect acceptance and supplies an optional label prefix stripped before matching.

Evaluation: normalize observed labels, apply the optional prefix, preserve declaration order, return separate required/advisory violations, and accept only when required violations are empty unless options promote advisories. Keep evaluate_labels compatible with comma-separated required rules.

Reporting: keep render_decision compatibility and add render_decision_with_options producing a stable multi-line report with decision, required violations, advisory violations, and counts. Add a public summary helper.

Update lib exports, focused parser/evaluator/report tests, one integration workflow test, README examples/API compatibility notes, and CHANGELOG. Do not add dependencies. Keep modules cohesive and facades thin. Run `cargo fmt`, `cargo test -q`, inspect the complete diff, and call submit_for_pr.
